_note: This repo builds its Playwright matrix from tests/ui-testing/ci-matrix/ci_matrix.json (single source of truth, consumed by .github/scripts/build-ci-matrix.js in playwright.yml). The new 'Synthetics' shard has been added directly to ci_matrix.json; this file is the machine-readable registration record for the PR-back job. No ENT overlay (ci_matrix.ent.json) exists in this OSS checkout — the enterprise repo applies its own overlay on top of the shared base.
